text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] By placing this Digimon as 1 of your other Digimon's bottom digivolution card, reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Return the revealed cards to the top or bottom of the deck. Then, if you have a Digimon with the [Legend-Arms] trait, gain 2 memory.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn] While you have a black or [Legend Arms] trait Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Raid＞.
